lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and apply character motivation.
teaching_sequence: Begin with an original short example connected to the learner's life.
Ask what the learner notices before giving formal explanation.
Model how to use textual clues or context.
Guide one response, then remove support.
Ask for an original example or retelling.

flashcards.back: Define character motivation, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define cause and consequence, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define change over time, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore character motivation
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on character motivation. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where cause and consequence is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach reflection and values to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
